prompt: I need you to create a comprehensive brand-styled presentation for Anthropic. Create a PowerPoint file named 'anthropic_presentation.pptx' that demonstrates all aspects of Anthropic's brand guidelines. The presentation must include: 1) A title slide with 'Anthropic Brand Showcase' as the main heading and 'Official Brand Guidelines Demo' as subtitle, 2) A slide showcasing all brand colors with their hex values displayed, 3) A typography demonstration slide showing both Poppins headings and Lora body text with sample content, 4) A slide with various shapes using the accent colors (orange, blue, green), and 5) A final slide with mixed content combining text, colors, and shapes. Each slide must use appropriate Anthropic brand colors for backgrounds and text. Make sure all headings use Poppins font and body text uses Lora font, with proper fallbacks to Arial and Georgia respectively.
